Position and floor-index writes in the collision query.

facts.rationale: Corrects the misleading exclusive alternative and records the shared query's observable mutation.
facts.value: Reads the Chef item's horizontal velocity and special attributes. Only when X velocity is nonzero does it call it_8026DAA8, whose terrain processing updates item position and may update the stored floor index. For result mask 0xC, it multiplies X velocity by -attrs->x4. Independently, for result mask 3, it calls it_802C875C, clearing X/Y velocity, initializing the terminal lifetime and selecting state 1. Both mask responses can execute in order during one call. The callback always returns false.

evidence.why: Exact multiplier, branch ordering and destination setup.

facts.rationale: Preserves the exceptional combined-mask path and avoids assuming an unobserved coefficient range.
facts.value: With zero X velocity, performs no collision query or transition and returns false. Otherwise, result mask 0xC scales X velocity by -attrs->x4 without itself selecting a state; attenuation depends on the attribute value. A separate subsequent test of mask 3 enters state 1, clearing X/Y velocity and initializing its terminal lifetime. If both masks are present, the state-1 transition follows and overrides the horizontal rebound. The callback always returns false.
